inferences.metric: Inherited predicates coded A or Q

range.basis: low = A only (Q excluded from the floor); high = A + Q

stat.display_rule: count + percentage + range through one sjn-stat component; never rendered as a bare percentage

inferences.direct_observation: Most inherited predicate families fall in A or Q rather than D.
